name: the-national-mail
description: The National Mail: a news website with a Next.js frontend, Express API and MySQL database

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,red "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,red "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
